key.name: columns
key.description: How many icons sit side by side. 2 gives the two-column stack.

key.name: icon-padding
key.description: Space in pixels around each icon, inside its hover highlight.

key.name: icon-spacing
key.description: Gap in pixels between neighbouring icons.

key.name: fill-from-bottom
key.description: The first icon sits at the bottom and new rows grow upwards. When off the stack grows downwards from the top.

key.name: icon-order
key.description: Remembered order of the icons, first entry is the first slot. Changed by dragging icons. Empty means the default order (system icons first, then tray icons).

key.name: split-bluetooth
key.description: Bluetooth opens its own popup (switch and devices) instead of the shared Quick Settings menu.

key.name: split-gsconnect
key.description: GSConnect (mobile devices) opens its own popup instead of the shared Quick Settings menu.

key.name: background-apps-button
key.summary: Background apps as a round button
key.description: Move the "Background Apps" tile of the full popup into a round button next to the screenshot button. Its list opens at the top of the popup.

key.name: visibility
key.description: Maps an item to "auto", "show" or "hide". Items starting with "icon:" are icons of the panel (show = always show, even while GNOME hides it); items starting with "tile:" are tiles and buttons of the full popup (hide = remove).

key.name: known-items
key.description: Filled in by the extension so the settings window can list every icon and tile, including tray apps that are not running right now.

key.name: icon-size
key.description: 0 follows the panel. Otherwise size in pixels.
